scope: U.S. companies that offered an eligible software product at any point during 2021–2024
membership_rule: Count company-years after dated product, U.S. location, and historical ownership checks. Include firms later acquired, renamed, or closed.

manifest_checks.name: CNCF landscape
manifest_checks.description: Cloud-native products, projects, and member entries

manifest_checks.name: LF AI & Data landscape
manifest_checks.description: AI and data products, projects, and member entries

discovery_routes.name: Historical landscapes
discovery_routes.role: Find dated product and project candidates, domains, and repositories.
discovery_routes.limit: Project and member entries need company, U.S., and product checks. 2022–2023 files remain to be parsed.

discovery_routes.name: SEC filing indexes
discovery_routes.role: Find in-period reporting companies and their original filings by CIK and filing date.
discovery_routes.limit: Filing status does not establish product fit; private companies are mostly absent.

discovery_routes.name: SEC Form D
discovery_routes.role: Find private issuer candidates in quarterly 2021–2024 offering notices.
discovery_routes.limit: Not a company or venture-round census. Amendments need deduplication.

discovery_routes.name: YC and dated announcements
discovery_routes.role: Find additional private candidates and historical company events.
discovery_routes.limit: Accelerator and publicity selection bias; present-day descriptions are not past evidence.

discovery_routes.name: Web archives
discovery_routes.role: Check historical product claims, domain aliases, and company activity.
discovery_routes.limit: A missing capture does not show that a company or product was absent.

next_batch: Freeze product, location, and historical ownership rules.
Build a source-tagged union, including firms that disappeared before 2024.
Review 50–100 candidates across the four categories and record exclusions.
Measure unique eligible additions, identity ambiguity, and dated evidence by company-year.
